findings.topic: unrestricted localization and uniform body variance
findings.reason: E0 controls every profitable state and has errors proportional to c, excluding arbitrarily tiny c>0 near the empty profile. C0/C4 then localize the entire lists and J loss. Dividing by D*kappa^2 and using the uniform bounded-moment expansion gives variance->1/4 without a rate assumption.

findings.topic: exact cost of every omitted anomaly
findings.reason: The actual fully assigned Schmidt witness is PSD. Positive kappa makes its inverse base PD. Nonnegative walks keep all selected-edge walks and 2*tau/a^2 from every remaining slot, including overlaps. The strictly increasing implicit cost gives c-c0>=1.6*tau with no additive error.

The retained theta has top R entries one and bottom K zero, so the changed contrast preserves the adverse spectral-pairing shape. The single-edge base is PD and its exact rank-one product is one. All edge permutations and zero Schmidt coordinates are covered; arbitrary middle theta stays feasible.

The raw increment excludes coordinate one, so there is no cross term with the retained head. Subtraction of actual logarithms cancels the leading signed trace mass. Remaining energy is <=eta*tau and all mean/quadratic errors are proportional to tau. Arbitrarily tiny tails are covered.

findings.topic: uniform contrast gain and strict finite tail/slack elimination
findings.reason: The exact derivative expands uniformly as 2*k*variance+O(k^2+1/D). Profitable-state localization supplies variance near 1/4 over the whole protection interval, giving derivative>=k/4. Its integrated coefficient tends to 1/8, so 1/10 is valid. The relative removal error <=tau/50 is strictly beaten using c-c0>=1.6*tau, including tau=0 with positive slack.

Every body cube point is genuinely feasible with fixed head. Trace reweighting yields a convex combination of normalized endpoint vertices. They are distinct because their common positive head fixes any rescaling. Strict purity convexity therefore excludes every interior body coordinate at an optimizer.

findings.topic: exact scalar/rank value and all matrix equality
findings.reason: Localization puts every nonbulk optimizer strictly inside [1,3]. All parameters in that compact interval are physical. The chord is exact, the real trace optimum has one sign change, and only floor/ceil can win. Both counts fit uniformly; the equivalent finite maximum of continuous branches proves attainment despite floor/ceil switches. Every unitary conjugate and all genuine ties are retained.

findings.topic: strict phase selection on the entire band
findings.reason: Q0-Q3 excludes every nonbulk optimizer at or above onset. Below onset the rational boundary profile has h-n>=1/8 uniformly throughout the band, not only at N-1. Its order m^-8 purity margin dominates the actual integer-rank loss of order m^-11. Thus bulk cannot win anywhere below onset in the stated band.

The assertion is ordinary and eventual for each fixed A. It claims neither an effective cutoff, all finite dimensions, other entropy orders, ASEP, scalar-parameter uniqueness, new major-conjecture solution, nor a Lean audit.
